subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Predicament
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Solution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Predicament"** means a difficult, unpleasant, or embarrassing situation. (कठिन परिस्थिति)

 
 
• **Example:** After losing his wallet, he found himself in a predicament as he had no money to get home.
 
 
 
• **"Solution"** refers to a means of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation. (समाधान)
 
 
• **Example:** The team worked together to find a solution to the company's financial issues.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'predicament'** is **'solution'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Solution**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Docile** (विनम्र): Ready to accept control or instruction; submissive.

 
 
• **Example:** The puppy was surprisingly docile and easy to train.
 
 
 
• **Mess** (गड़बड़): A situation that is confused or full of difficulty.
 
 
• **Example:** Her apartment was in a complete mess after the party.
 
 
 
• **Redeem** (मुक्त करना): To make something or someone seem less bad or to save something.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to redeem himself by apologizing for his mistakes.
